text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Friday. Reuters has not verified them and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- A poll conducted among 2,800 Macedonians says that 51.71 percent ask for the resolution of economic problems at local elections. Almost 13 percent percent will vote for the ruling SDSM, 10.29 for the Demcoratic party, 9.70 percent for the (ethnic Albanian) PDP, 7.86 percent for the IMRO-DPMNY, 3.4 for the Liberal party and 2 percent for the Socialist party.

- Macedonian President Kiro Goligorov met U.S. Secretary of State Warren Christopher in New York. U.S. values Macedonia's policy in the region. Macedonia received British support for its candidacy as a non-permanent member of the Security Council.
- Liberal party leader Stojan Andov said some government departments manipulated voters lists in Macedonia's last elections in November 1994.
